title: I wanna be loved by you - MARILYN MONROE

lines.l: I'm keeping my face in a job by the door, I want to know what is it for
Where are the lonely people? Where do they all come from?
Oh, the lonely people, where do they all belong?
Father McKenzie, writing the words to a sermon that no one will hear
Down in his socks in the night
Where do they all come from?
Was buried along with her name
Wiping the dirt from his hands
As he walked from the grave
Saying, all of the lonely people, where do they come from? All over the world, the lonely, lonely, lonely people, where do they all know?
Lonely, Lonely the Lonely, Lonely the Lonely, Lonely the Lonely, Lonely the Lonely people know
